Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the Reception module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval before it
is built into the app. It is for everyone who works a clinic's Reception desk: the front gate
of every visit, and the desk that takes the money the clinic is owed today.
What is in it: 36 How do I…? cards in six groups, 12 rules, 12 lessons with 36 check
questions, and 5 sign-off tasks.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or an old manual. No fee, limit or allowance is printed as a figure where it is a
clinic setting; the guide names the setting instead.
Screenshots: staging renders with one made-up patient; every other name and every
phone number is hidden. Nine are placed. The others are shown as [Screenshot to add
…] lines until they are rendered.
Who signs off a reception joiner: the clinic's BM.
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for. You open every visit and you take the money the clinic is owed
today. Nothing in the clinic starts until you check a patient in: until then she is on nobody's
list — not the doctor's, not the counsellor's, not the therapist's. You collect each payment
exactly as the counsellor prepared it, and you make sure it is on the record with a receipt.
You own Check-in (the clinic's front gate) · the consultation
fee for a new patient · creating a walk-in patient ·
collecting every prepared payment (cash, card
machine, manual payment, split) · cancelling a
payment link so she can pay at the desk · receipts ·
the counter product sale · product exchanges ·
assigning therapists and planning their day · the
online team's pickups and Rapido boxes at this
clinic
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 1 of 39

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.text:
Your day, from opening to the day-end lock.
1 . Open Check-in. The Expected tab is today's bookings not checked in yet.
2. As each patient arrives: find her, open her card, settle the fee if she is new, press the
main button. She is now on the doctor's and counsellor's lists.
3. When the doctor signs off: give each treatment a therapist on Assign therapist or the
Therapist planner.
4. When the counsellor prepares a payment: collect it on Awaiting payments, exactly as
prepared.
5. Through the day: counter sales (Product sale), exchanges (Product exchange), online
pickups and Rapido boxes.
6. End of day: on Today's collections, count the drawer against the cash total and the
card machine settlement against the card total; send any receipt under Receipts not
sent. Then the BM locks the day.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them. Know them
anyway, so a refusal never surprises you.
You never decide The price or what she pays (the counsellor
prepares it — you never change a prepared
amount) · the treatment (the doctor) · closing a
patient (only the counsellor) · approving your own
correction (the Sales Head decides it; the BM sees
it) · approving an exchange (the Sales Head) ·
locking the day (the BM) · no-shows (marked at day
close; the BM confirms them)
Hands off to you The booking desk and agents (bookings for today) ·
the counsellor and the BM (payments waiting on
Awaiting payments) · the doctor (a signed-off visit
that needs a therapist) · the online team (pickups
and Rapido orders)
You hand off to The doctor and the counsellor (a checked-in
patient lands on both lists at once) · the therapist
(once you assign her) · the BM (fee waivers,
corrections and the day's cash and card totals,
checked at day end)
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 2 of 39

blocks.title: Page 3
blocks.text:
The rule Why
Check-in is the single front gate. Until a visit is checked in, nobody else can
record anything on it — no sign-off, no
session, no payment.
One person, one record. The phone number
is the identity.
Her money, her plan and her follow-ups stay
together. The app checks the number across
every clinic before a new record can exist.
You never type an amount for a prepared
payment.
The counsellor (or the BM) prepares every
payment; you collect each line exactly as
prepared. A different amount goes back to
the counsellor with a note. The one place you
type an amount is a balance payment after
the visit closed, and it can never be more
than what she owes.
Nothing on the check-in card is saved until
you press the main button.
The fee, the counsellor and the visit are one
action. The exceptions say so on screen: the
card machine (it checks her in the moment it
says paid), "Permanently" changing the
counsellor, and the "Sessions from before"
answer.
Only a new patient pays the consultation
fee, and only once a day.
The fee is for the first consultation. A same-
day return has no second fee.
Money on file is never used unless you tick
it, and never overspent.
An advance or token is only spent on
purpose, and never beyond what is left on it.
What is left stays usable.
Every fee waiver goes on the patient's
permanent record, and the BM verifies it
before the day locks.
Money given up is checked by someone else.
Never charge again when the machine
might have taken the money.
A payment can land late. The app asks the
bank first before any new charge.
A collected payment is never edited or
declined — it is corrected with an
amendment.
Nothing is ever deleted from the money
record. The original stays on it.
Store credit is never paid out in cash. An exchange that leaves us owing her goes
to her available credit.
You never hard-close a patient. Only the counsellor closes a patient.
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 3 of 39

blocks.title: Page 4
blocks.text:
3 · Processes
My pages
The menu is down the left in four groups. On a phone, ☰  opens the whole menu and the
bar at the bottom holds Check-in, Assign, Awaiting, Collections and Patients.
Front desk
Check-in — your first page. A search box ("Phone or name…") and New patient (walk-
in) on top. With the box empty you see today's floor in tabs: Expected (split into "New
appointments for today" and "Revisits for today"), Checked in, Done, No-show,
Cancelled.
Check-in History — the same floor for any past day, read-only, with Export CSV (up to
31 days).
Assign therapist — who takes each signed-off treatment, with every therapist's load.
A coral number is how many are waiting.
Therapist planner — drag each signed-off treatment onto a therapist's lane to give it a
therapist and a start time.
Clinic Overview — view only: who is waiting for sign-off, for a therapist, or late for
numbing or a treatment, with the delay alarms.
Clinic Timeline — view only: today's planned steps in time order, with a "now" line.
Awaiting payments — everything prepared for you to collect, from any day. The coral
number is what is still open.
Patients
All patients — your clinic's patient book. Open › opens the record.
All appointments — every appointment and booking between two dates. Change date
moves a booking nobody has checked in yet.
Next appointments — patients brought over from the old system with sessions left
and no next visit. It is in the menu only while there is someone to set.
Sales & collections
Today's collections — today's money, one line each, with the totals for the day-end
count; Receipts not sent; corrections ( ⋯  → Amend…).
The rule Why
A future appointment never shows
recording screens.
Only a checked-in visit can be worked on.
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 4 of 39

blocks.title: Page 5
blocks.text:
Product orders — the record of counsellors' product orders that were paid and
handed over, or sent back.
Handed over — the record of online pickups this desk handed over.
Online orders
Pickups — online orders a customer collects at your counter.
Rapido orders — online orders you pack and hand to the Rapido rider.
In the header: + New patient (walk-in), + Product sale, ⇄  Product exchange, the search
box (narrows the page you are on), ? (How to use, Report a bug), and your name (profile
and Sign out).
How do I…? · Check-in
1. How do I check in a patient booked for today?
When you need this: a patient with a booking or appointment for today arrives.
Steps:
1 . Open Check-in. Find her on the Expected tab, or type her phone or name in "Phone or
name…".
2. Press Check in. Her check-in card opens.
3. Read "Routing today" at the top: where she goes, and "Outstanding balance — see
counsellor" if she owes money.
4. If she is new, settle the consultation fee (card 6).
5. Read the right-hand rail. "Still needed: …" names anything missing.
6. Press Confirm visit.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"<name> checked in — on the doctor & counsellor queue".
The button stays grey while something is still needed; the reason is written under it.
"Still checking whether the consultation fee is due — one moment."
"Couldn't load the fee & consent check for this patient — …" with Retry. Retry before
taking any fee.
Who to ask: the BM if a card will not let you check her in.
Search words: check in, check-in, patient aa gayi, arrived, booking, appointment, confirm
visit, expected
Screenshot:
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 5 of 39

blocks.title: Page 6
blocks.text:
2. How do I check in someone with no booking (an existing patient)?
When you need this: a patient already on the system walks in without a booking.
Steps:
1 . Search her phone or name on Check-in.
2. On her row press Check in as walk-in.
3. If the app finds a booking on her number, read it: "This number is booked for … —
Check them in through it so the visit counts to the booking." Press Check this booking
in instead if it is her.
4. If it is someone else, tick "Someone else — not <name>".
5. Press Check in as walk-in.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"<name> checked in — walk-in on the queue".
"an answer on the booking for this number (check them in on it, or mark it someone
else)" — answer the booking question first.
An agent is credited only through the booking, so always check her in on her booking
when it is hers.
Who to ask: the booking desk, if the booking looks wrong.
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 6 of 39

blocks.title: Page 7
blocks.text:
Search words: walk-in, bina booking, no appointment, direct aa gayi, existing patient,
purana patient
[Screenshot to add: walk-in card with the booking question]
3. How do I add a brand-new patient?
When you need this: someone not in the system anywhere walks in.
Steps:
1 . Press + New patient (walk-in) in the header (or New patient (walk-in) on Check-in).
2. Type the Phone first. Wait for " ✓  no duplicate (network-checked)".
3. Type the Full name.
4. Routing today: See doctor (a consultation) or Counsellor only · price enquiry (no
doctor, no fee).
5. Pick the counsellor under Allocate counsellor.
6. For See doctor, settle the consultation fee (card 6).
7. Press Create & check in.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Already with us — <name> is a patient at this clinic." → press Check in from their
record. Nothing new is created.
"<name> is already a patient at <clinic>. … No new record is created here." → find her
in the Check-in search under "Patient of <clinic>" and press Check in as walk-in.
"This number is already a contact on the network — … check this person in on the
record they already have." → press Check in as walk-in.
"This number is booked — …" → press Move to today & check in or Pull forward &
check in if it is the same person.
"Walk-in created — checked in, on the queue".
Who to ask: the BM, if a record looks wrong. Never make a second record for one person.
Search words: new patient, naya patient, register, add patient, walk-in, new walkin, first
visit, enquiry
Screenshot:
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)

blocks.title: Page 8
blocks.text:
4. How do I check in a patient who missed an earlier visit?
When you need this: she missed or no-showed a recent visit and is here now.
Steps:
1 . Search her on Check-in. Her row shows coral "No-show <date>" or "Missed <date>",
and Pull forward & check in.
2. Press it. The card shows "Previous visit on <date> went no-show/was missed, so
pulling that appointment to today."
3. Finish the card and press Pull forward to today & check in.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the old date stays on the record as the planned date.
How far back a missed visit can be pulled forward is a clinic setting.
Who to ask: the BM.
Search words: missed, no show, pull forward, purani booking, missed appointment, aaj
check in
[Screenshot to add: search row with No-show tag and Pull forward & check in]
5. How do I check in someone who is booked for a later day but came today?
When you need this: her booking is for another day.
Steps:
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 8 of 39

blocks.title: Page 9
blocks.text:
1 . Search her on Check-in. Her row shows amber "Booked for <date>".
2. To use that booking today, press Move to today & check in. The card says "Booked for
<date> by <who>, so moving that appointment to today." Finish the card and press
Move to today & check in.
3. To leave the later booking where it is, press Walk-in instead — that booking "stays
open and this visit will not count to it".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the booked date stays on the record as the planned
date, and the visit counts to that booking.
Who to ask: the booking desk, if she wants the later booking moved instead.
Search words: booked for later, early aa gayi, move to today, advance booking, future
booking, walk-in instead
[Screenshot to add: search row with Walk-in instead and Move to today & check in]
How do I…? · The consultation fee and old patients
6. How do I take the consultation fee for a new patient?
When you need this: a new patient checking in to see the doctor.
Steps:
1 . On her check-in card, find Consultation fee. The amount comes from the clinic's
setting.
2. Choose how she pays: Cash, Automatic POS, Manual payment, or Waive fee.
3. Cash: take the cash, press Confirm cash, then Yes, in the drawer.
4. Automatic POS: press the machine's button ("Send to <bank>"). It unlocks only once
the rest of the card is ready, because the visit is checked in the moment the machine
says paid.
5. Manual payment: choose how she paid, type the transaction ID, attach the screenshot,
press Record ₹ ….
6. Press Confirm visit (not needed after Automatic POS — it checks her in itself).
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
No fee block → she is not new, or the fee is settled today. Take nothing.
"Paid today ✓  … — a same-day return has no second fee."
"Covered by the consultation fee paid ahead."
"Couldn't check the available credit — retry above before taking any fee. She may have
paid this already."
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 9 of 39

blocks.title: Page 10
blocks.text:
"Undo the cash in the drawer first — the fee is already taken this way." — press Undo
to switch method.
Who to ask: the BM.
Search words: consultation fee, fees, consult fee, fee lena, first visit fee, cash, card, UPI,
POS
Screenshot:
7. How do I use money she already paid (an advance or token) toward the fee?
When you need this: the card says she has available credit.
Steps:
1 . Read the banner on her card — for example "Advance … paid & verified via the booking
desk".
2. Money paid for the consultation that covers the whole fee is used by itself: "Covered
by the consultation fee paid ahead."
3. Any other credit is used only if you tick it under "Available credit — tick one to put
toward this fee. Nothing is used unless you tick it."
4. If the credit covers only part, collect the rest by Cash, Automatic POS or Manual
payment.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 10 of 39

blocks.title: Page 11
blocks.text:
"… — ₹ … still to collect."
"awaiting reception — usable once collected" — a token not collected yet cannot pay
the fee.
A waived fee cannot also draw on credit: untick it or collect the rest.
Who to ask: the counsellor, for credit she wants on a treatment instead.
Search words: advance, token, credit, pehle diya, already paid, booking advance, money
on file
[Screenshot to add: fee section with Available credit ticks]
8. How do I waive the consultation fee?
When you need this: she paid online at booking, or there is another real reason.
Steps:
1 . On Consultation fee, choose Waive fee.
2. Pick the reason: Paid online at booking, or Other and type why ("Say why. This goes on
the permanent record.").
3. Press Confirm visit.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the waiver goes on her permanent record and onto the
BM's end-of-day list. The day cannot be locked until the BM verifies it. For a patient with a
Gleuhr card who is not in the system, do not waive — use Existing · no record (card 9).
Who to ask: the BM.
Search words: waive, waiver, fee maaf, free consultation, no fee, paid online
[Screenshot to add: Waive fee with the reason chips]
9. How do I check in an old patient whose record is not on the CRM?
When you need this: she has a Gleuhr treatment card but is not in the system.
Steps:
1 . On her check-in card, under Patient type, choose Existing · no record.
2. The fee shows "Waived · existing patient" — "No fee to take. The BM checks it against
the card on End of Day."
3. Under Sessions on her card, add one line per treatment: the treatment, Planned and
Given, copied from her card. + Add another treatment for more. Tick "No sessions left
on her card" if nothing is left.
4. Take a Photo of the card (optional).
5. Press the main button. One press checks her in and records the card.
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)

"… has more sessions given (…) than planned (…) — fix the numbers"
"She is checked in — the card photo did not save" → Try the photo again or Go on

Who to ask: the BM.

airtable

10. How do I answer "Sessions from before" for an imported patient?
When you need this: the card asks "Does the patient have any active treatment with
sessions left?"
Steps:
1 . Ask her. Choose Yes, No or Not sure — the doctor will check.
2. For Yes, add each package: Total sessions and Already done.
3. Press Save the answer. It saves at once, separately from the check-in.
4. Finish the check-in.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Saved straight away, separately from the check-in. No
money is recorded here." "Package N: already done cannot be more than the total".
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)

Search words: sessions from before, imported, old sessions, purane sessions, airtable,
kitne bache

How do I…? · Counsellors, therapists and the floor
11. How do I pick or change the counsellor at check-in?
When you need this: she has no counsellor, or her counsellor is absent, or she wants
someone else.
Steps:
1 . No counsellor: under Allocate counsellor, pick one. It saves with the check-in.
2. Change for today only: under Counsellor today, press Change → Just for today →
pick. Her counsellor stays the counsellor of record.
3. Change for good: Change → Permanently → pick → type Why → press Change
counsellor of record. This saves at once.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
If her counsellor is absent, the card stays shut until you pick someone Just for today.
"Counsellor of record changed to <name>. N open follow-up(s) moved with the
patient."
After check-in, the record's visit pop-up has Change for today.
Who to ask: the BM, for a permanent change you are unsure of.
Search words: counsellor, change counsellor, counsellor absent, allocate, assign
counsellor, kaun dekhega
[Screenshot to add: Counsellor today with Just for today / Permanently]
12. How do I send a counsellor-only patient to the doctor too?
When you need this: she came for a price enquiry only and now wants to see the doctor.
Steps:
1 . On Check-in, Checked in tab, open the row's ⋯  menu → Send to the doctor · ₹ … (or
search her and press Send to the doctor).
2. Collect the consultation fee shown (Cash, Automatic POS, Manual payment or Bank
transfer).
3. Press Send to the doctor (or "Collect … & send to the doctor").
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 13 of 39

blocks.title: Page 14
blocks.text:
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "<name> is now a doctor consult — they are on the
doctor's list." There is no waiver here: "no fee was ever due to forgive."
Who to ask: the counsellor.
Search words: send to doctor, doctor bhi dikhana, upgrade, consult, price enquiry to
doctor
[Screenshot to add: Send to the doctor card]
13. How do I undo a check-in done by mistake?
When you need this: you checked in the wrong patient or visit.
Steps:
1 . On Check-in, Checked in tab, open the row's ⋯  menu.
2. Press Undo check-in.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: it is refused once anything is recorded on the visit:
"Money is already recorded on this visit — undo is closed"
"The consultation fee is waived on this visit — undo is closed"
"The doctor has already signed off on this visit — undo is closed"
"The counsellor has closed this visit — ask the BM"
Who to ask: the BM.
Search words: undo check in, galti se check in, wrong patient, cancel check in, reverse
[Screenshot to add: ⋯  menu with Undo check-in]
14. How do I give a signed-off treatment to a therapist?
When you need this: the doctor signed off and the treatment is under "Therapist
allocation pending".
Steps:
1 . Open Assign therapist. Select a patient on the left.
2. On the right, read each therapist's load ("free", "N waiting", "in a session").
3. Press Assign (or Next to queue her for a busy therapist). It saves at once.
4. For a patient with several treatments, "Same person for all N sessions" is on by default.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Once a session has started, the assignment is locked.
"No active therapist is set up for this clinic — the branch manager adds them before a
sitting can be allocated."
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)

15. How do I pick who numbs a patient?
When you need this: a signed-off treatment needs numbing and you want a named
therapist to apply it.
Steps:
1 . On Assign therapist, select the treatment.
2. Under Numbing by, open "Pick who numbs" and choose a therapist.
3. To clear it: "Clear — any therapist may numb".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "<name> will numb <patient>." The picked therapist
sees it first on her list, and the session's therapist sees "<name> to numb". "Nobody
picked — any therapist may numb."
Who to ask: the doctor.

16. How do I plan the therapists' day on the planner?
When you need this: to give each signed-off treatment a start time.
Steps:
1 . Open Therapist planner. The left column lists "Therapist allocation pending".
2. Drag a patient onto a therapist's lane (on a phone, press and hold, or tap the patient
then a green slot). "Best · start …" marks the best slot.
3. If the slot is busy, the app asks first, for example "Start <name> after her current
patient, at …?" or "Move them".
4. To take her off the plan, drag the block back to the left column.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: a treatment already started cannot be moved. "<name>
is absent today." "The planner couldn't save that. The screen has been refreshed — try
again."
Who to ask: the doctor or the BM.
Search words: planner, schedule, time dena, slot, therapist plan, drag, timing

17. How do I see who is waiting and who is late?
When you need this: to keep the floor moving.
Steps:
1 . Open Clinic Overview. Tabs: "1 Waiting session sign-off", "2 Therapist allocation
pending", "3 Numbing & treatment". The Delay alarms column lists every alarm.
2. Or open Clinic Timeline and use Late.
3. Tap a patient to see her steps; Open record opens her record.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: both pages are view only — "View only · the step is
someone else’s". An alarm clears only when the step is done.
Who to ask: the doctor (sign-off) or the therapist (late start).
Search words: overview, waiting, late, delay, alarm, timeline, kaun wait kar raha
Screenshot:
How do I…? · Collecting payments
18. How do I collect a payment the counsellor prepared?
When you need this: a payment is waiting on Awaiting payments.
Steps:
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 17 of 39

blocks.title: Page 18
blocks.text:
1 . Open Awaiting payments. Find the payment and press Collect payment ›.
2. Read "Amount to collect".
3. If there is an "Available credit" line, press Use the credit → Yes, use the credit.
4. Under "How is she paying?", choose Cash, Automatic POS, Manual payment or Split,
and collect.
5. Check "Receipt goes to" — read her number back.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"All collected. Receipt sent to … It moves to Today’s collections."
"Package — creates on collection": the course does not exist until you collect.
"Exact amounts only — if she is paying something different, send it back to
<counsellor> with a note."
Who to ask: the counsellor who raised it.
Search words: collect payment, payment lena, awaiting, package payment, installment,
pay, collect
Screenshot:
19. How do I take a card payment on the machine?
When you need this: she pays by card or UPI on the clinic's card machine.
Steps:
1 . Choose Automatic POS.
2. Press the machine's button ("Send to <bank>"; the MID is under it).
3. "Waiting on <machine>" — she taps, inserts the card or scans the UPI QR on the
machine. Do not press again.
4. "Paid on <machine>" → Done.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Not paid: … The bank declined it. Try again, use the other machine, or record it by
hand."
"Couldn’t reach <machine>" — the machine is off or has no signal. Nothing was taken.
"The internet dropped" — look at the machine; the screen finds the charge by itself
when the internet is back.
Gleuhr Guide — Reception (draft)
Page 18 of 39

blocks.title: Page 19
blocks.text:
"The bank hasn’t confirmed it yet" — don't charge again; press Check with the bank in
a minute.
"Cancelled on <machine>" → Send again (it asks the bank first) or Choose another
way.
Who to ask: the BM.
Search words: card, machine, POS, swipe, UPI, QR, card machine, HDFC, Razorpay POS,
tap
[Screenshot to add: the card machine pop-up "Waiting on <machine>"]
20. How do I record a payment she made another way (manual payment)?
When you need this: she paid by UPI to the clinic, by card on a machine not started from
the CRM, or the machine fell over.
Steps:
1 . Choose Manual payment.
2. Paid by: choose how she paid (the list comes from the clinic's settings).

5: you did it alone, right first time, at normal desk speed.

What the rater looks at in every task:
Steps: the right steps, in order, with nothing skipped.
Screen: the right page and buttons; refusals read and acted on.
Rules: this module's rules kept.
The people you deal with: clear and polite with the patient, and handed off to the right
colleague.
Pace: done at normal desk speed.
Ratings are not averaged. For example, 5, 5, 4, 3, 5 is "not yet": you repeat only the task
rated 3. No single mistake fails a task on its own; a mistake lowers that task's rating.
Every attempt and every rating is kept. You are In training until every lesson is passed
AND every task is rated 4 or 5. Then your BM signs you off as Trained. Nothing on your
desk is blocked while you are In training.
How it works: do the lessons in order. Read each lesson and its cards, then answer its 3
questions. If you fail, re-read the cards and try again.
Lesson 1 — The front gate
Check-in opens every visit. Until you press the main button, nobody else can work on her.
You never decide prices, treatments, or closing a patient. Read: cards 1, 13.
Q1. A patient arrives but is not checked in yet. Can the doctor sign her off?
a) Yes · b) No ✓
Why: check-in is the single front gate.
Q2. Who closes a patient for good?
a) Reception · b) The doctor · c) The counsellor ✓
Why: only the counsellor hard-closes a patient.
Q3. You checked in the wrong patient and nothing is recorded yet. What do you do?
a) Undo check-in ✓  · b) Ask the doctor · c) Leave it
Why: undo works until anything is recorded on the visit.

Q2. The app says "She had already paid this link — her payment is applied." What do you
collect?
a) Nothing ✓  · b) The full amount · c) Half
Why: her payment is already applied.
Q3. The link is a PayU link. Can you cancel it here?
a) Yes · b) No — it stays out until it expires ✓
Why: the CRM can cancel only Razorpay links.
Lesson 10 — Corrections, receipts and the day end
Raise an amendment for a wrong cash or card figure; someone else decides it. Send every
unsent receipt. Count the drawer and the machine settlement. Read: cards 24, 25.
Q1. Who decides your amendment?
a) You · b) The Sales Head (your BM sees it) ✓  · c) The counsellor
Why: no one approves their own correction.
Q2. Can you amend a UPI payment from the desk?
a) Yes · b) No — tell your BM ✓
Why: an amendment covers cash and card only.
Q3. Who locks the day?
a) Reception · b) The BM ✓  · c) The Sales Head
Why: oversight is the BM's.

Lesson 11 — Products and exchanges
Counter sales and product orders scan every unit. Exchanges need the Sales Head; we
never refund cash. Read: cards 26, 27, 28.
Q1. An exchange leaves us owing her. What does she get?
a) Cash · b) Store credit ✓  · c) Nothing
Why: store credit is never paid out in cash.
Q2. When does stock move on an exchange?
a) At once · b) Only after the Sales Head approves ✓
Why: "Nothing moves until then."
Q3. You give a discount above the running offer on Custom offer. What happens?
a) It is blocked · b) It is allowed and flagged to the BM and the Sales Head ✓
Why: above the offer is allowed, never hidden.
Lesson 12 — The online desk
Pickups: scan, take what is due (card, UPI or cash), Order picked up. Rapido: scan, Mark
dispatched, no money. Read: cards 29, 30.
Q1. A pickup customer wants to pay by bank transfer. Can you take it?
a) Yes · b) No — card, UPI or cash only ✓
Why: "a bank transfer isn’t taken here."
Q2. A Rapido box is not paid online. What do you do?
a) Take the money from the rider · b) Don't send it; the online team takes the payment
first ✓  · c) Send it anyway
Why: Rapido orders are prepaid only.
Q3. Can you undo Mark dispatched?
a) Yes · b) No — not from this desk ✓
Why: the box has left with the rider.
Ready for sign-off: what your BM will ask you to show
On the real desk, with your BM watching. Each task is rated 1 to 5, and each needs a 4 or 5.
1 . Check in a booked patient, and a new walk-in with See doctor, taking the
consultation fee by UPI on the card machine or by Manual payment.

blocks.text:
What a 5 looks like: finds her on today's list, checks her in on her booking, records the
fee by UPI on the machine (or Manual payment with the transaction ID and
screenshot), her number read back so the receipt reaches her, and she lands on the
doctor's and counsellor's lists; the walk-in is made phone-first with no second record.
2. Check in a patient who missed a visit (Pull forward & check in), and handle a patient
whose counsellor is absent.
What a 5 looks like: spots the No-show tag and uses Pull forward & check in; when the
counsellor is absent, picks someone Just for today and tells the patient who will see
her.
3. Collect a prepared package payment on Awaiting payments, including one split
between cash and card, and check the number the receipt goes to.
What a 5 looks like: collects exactly the prepared figure, never types a different one;
splits cash and card with each part confirmed; reads her number back before the
receipt goes; sends back with a note if she wants to pay differently.
4. Give two signed-off treatments to therapists on Assign therapist or the Therapist
planner.
What a 5 looks like: picks the right treatment from "Therapist allocation pending",
checks the therapist's load first, uses Next for a busy therapist, and does not touch a
started sitting.
5. At the end of the day, read Today's collections against the drawer and the machine
settlement, and send any receipt under Receipts not sent.
What a 5 looks like: the drawer matches the cash total and the machine settlement
matches the card total, or the difference is raised as an amendment with a reason;
every receipt under Receipts not sent is sent; nothing left waiting without a word to
the BM.
